description: Returns one page of the changelog of EOL Watch, newest first: items added, effective dates changed, items updated and items withdrawn. Use it to see what changed since you last read the data.

change.description: Only this kind of change: added, date_changed, updated or withdrawn.

cloud.description: Only changes to items of this cloud.

page.description: Page of the changelog, from 1. One page holds 50 changes, and a page past the end is the last page.

name: recent_changes

count.description: Number of changes in this answer.

generated_at.description: Moment this answer was built (ISO 8601, UTC).

items.description: The changes of this page, newest first.

effective_date.description: Date the change takes effect (YYYY-MM-DD), or null when not announced. For month, quarter and year precision this is the first day of the period.

effective_precision.description: How exact effective_date is: day, month, quarter or year.

after.description: For a date change: the effective date after it. Null for every other change.

effective_date.description: Date the change takes effect (YYYY-MM-DD), or null when not announced. For month, quarter and year precision this is the first day of the period.

effective_precision.description: How exact effective_date is: day, month, quarter or year.

before.description: For a date change: the effective date before it. Null for every other change.

change.description: Kind of change: added (the item was published), date_changed (its effective date changed), updated (another field changed) or withdrawn (the item is no longer listed).

cloud.description: Cloud the item belongs to: azure, aws, gcp, oci or multi.

json_url.description: The item as JSON, or null without a page.

markdown_url.description: The item as Markdown, or null without a page.

slug.description: Slug of the item the change is about.

source_url.description: Page the item was verified against: an official vendor page, or the endoflife.date page for the few products where it is the only source of the date.

text.description: The change in one sentence, as the changelog page words it.

url.description: Page of the item, or null when the item has no page: it was withdrawn.

name.description: Name of the license, or the words that say none is chosen yet.

note.description: What that means for reuse of the data.

url.description: Address of the license text, or null when there is none.

page.description: The page this answer holds. A page past the end is the last page.

query.description: The query as it was understood.

change.description: Kind of change asked for (added, date_changed, updated or withdrawn), or null.

cloud.description: Cloud asked for, or null for every cloud.

site.description: The site the data comes from.

total.description: Number of changes that match the query.

title: List recent changes
